causalScope.explanation: The ResultLines pattern builder is identical, but the timed PdfPageHighlights.ensurePage consumer changed from stream/await iteration to synchronous iteration. ResultLines is a treatment workload.

method.processStatistic: Median of seven complete two-page passes, after one discarded warmup pass.
method.pairs: Adjacent process medians, AB launches 1/2 and BA launches 4/3 within each block.
method.blockEffect: Geometric mean of the two candidate/baseline ratios; negative percent means faster.
method.overallEffect: Geometric mean of the three block ratios, each block weighted equally.

assessment.literalAndMarks: All six adjacent pairs and all three balanced blocks are faster for both workloads; the overall and block-level direction also agree when each process is represented by its mean instead of its median.
assessment.resultLines: Mixed direction across blocks and pairs. The initial +41.65% pooled-pass p50 slowdown does not recur consistently, but these observations do not establish an improvement or prove non-regression.
assessment.resultLinesEstimatorSensitivity: Balanced geometric block effect is -2.27%; ratio of the two groups' medians of process medians is +4.81%. Both are small relative to process variation and do not justify choosing a favorable direction.
assessment.resultLinesDispersion: Baseline process medians range 2.066-3.316 ms; candidate process medians range 1.886-3.134 ms. Individual passes show substantial variation within the same process.
assessment.microtasks: ResultLines scheduled microtasks are reproducibly 450 to 4 per two-page audit, with 444 matches unchanged. This is a deterministic work reduction, separately observed from elapsed time.
assessment.productClaimRecommendation: Claim reproducible literal/marks helper timing improvements and exact microtask reductions; disclose the mixed ResultLines elapsed times. Do not claim universal search speedup or UI latency improvement.

limitations: Only three follow-up ABBA blocks on one CI host; there is no general hardware-population estimate.
Seven repeated passes within a process are dependent observations, not seven independent launches.
The original campaign used another host and is shown separately, not pooled into the follow-up effect.
Actual app helper with preloaded real text; extraction and UI frame latency are excluded.
Timing and untimed microtask audits are separate; reduced microtasks do not prove lower elapsed time.
ResultLines uses the modified consumer and cannot be dismissed as a negative control.
